mapper.select: SELECT id, event_type AS eventType, stream_key AS streamKey, partition_key AS partitionKey, payload::text AS payload, retry_count AS retryCount FROM t_outbox_event WHERE status = 0 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= now()) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_retry_at, created_at), created_at, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_outbox_event SET status = 1, sent_at = now(), next_retry_at = NULL, last_attempt_at = now(), last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 0

UPDATE t_outbox_event SET retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = now() + (#{delayMillis} * interval '1 millisecond'), last_attempt_at = now(), last_error = #{lastError} WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 0
UPDATE t_outbox_event SET status = 2, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = NULL, last_attempt_at = now(), last_error = #{lastError} WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 0
